# UMC 2016–2025 audited financial history

Built 2026-10-19 from ten locally archived SEC Form 20-F annual reports for fiscal 2016–2025. The original fiscal year's filing is the default historical series. Each flow year is January 1–December 31; balance-sheet data are December 31. Financial statements are consolidated IFRS as issued by the IASB, in New Taiwan dollars. No selected-financial-data rounded millions, parent-only statements, USD convenience translations, press-release non-GAAP series, or companyfacts contexts were used to select financial values.

## Files and use

- history-original-v1.csv / .json: ten original annual observations, direct and derived fields.
- history-latest-comparative-v1.csv / .json: latest available audited comparative for each individual field. A later filing which omits a line does not establish zero or erase its earlier observation. In particular the 2016 original prepayments cash-flow line remains available alongside its later aggregated line; do not sum both without the standardized aggregation rule below.
- history-observations-v1.json and history-field-provenance-v1.csv: all extracted observations, including pre-2016 comparatives, with exact source values, units, reported-dash flags, original/comparative status, SEC URL, filing date, SHA-256, and row/cell XPath.
- history-comparative-differences-v1.json: changed values in later audited comparatives, preserving original and later provenance.
- history-validation-v1.json: accounting and note reconciliations; missing coverage is explicit.
- history-sources-v1.json: original source links, hashes and audited-statement unit-header XPaths.
- history-breaks-v1.json: source-grounded adoption, consolidation and presentation discontinuities.
- history-field-definitions-v1.json: direct-field aliases and explicit derived-field formulas.
- build_history.py: deterministic extraction/validation script; does not fetch sources.

## Units, signs and precision

All financial amounts are NT$ millions. Audited-statement NT$ thousand values are divided by exactly 1,000; original amounts remain in the observation ledger. EPS stays NT$ per common share. Weighted-average and issued-share quantities are millions of ordinary shares, converted from explicitly labeled thousand-share disclosures. They are not ADS quantities. Parenthetical values are negative. A printed dash is retained with reported_dash=true and represented numerically as zero for that reported line only. A missing/unpresented line is not fabricated as zero; CSV fields are blank where no observation exists.

The zero-valued 2016–2017 SBC CFO adjustment is a reported dash, not verified company-wide nil SBC expense. Key-management compensation separately includes small share-based amounts. Later cash-settled stock-appreciation-right expense also prevents treating the CFO addback as a complete SBC expense measure. The model-facing field is deliberately sbc_cf_addback, with sbc_cf_reported_dash status.

## Measurement choices

Revenue, gross profit and reported EBIT are the audited income-statement lines. Reported EBIT includes net other operating income/expense, including operating grants and other non-recurring items; it is not a normalized EBIT estimate. Total net income and net income attributable to the parent are distinct; losses attributed to NCI can make parent income exceed group income. Income tax expense is the negative of the income statement's signed tax line, preserving the 2018 tax benefit as a negative expense. The effective tax rate uses consolidated pretax income, not parent income or EBIT.

CFO is as reported and includes interest received, dividends received, interest paid and income taxes paid. It is not unlevered free cash flow. Cash PPE and intangible expenditure are actual investing cash outflows, not accrual additions, headline capex guidance or announced budgets. Acquisitions, grants and disposals are separately retained. FCF variants are arithmetic descriptions, not valuation conclusions. Post-2019 lease principal is financing cash flow; the lease-adjusted FCF field separately subtracts it. No pre-2019 IFRS16 liability or lease-principal series is backcast.

D&A is depreciation plus amortization from the CFO reconciliation. IFRS16 changes the scope of depreciation from 2019; do not interpret the entire reported series as identical cash operating costs. The cash-flow 'operating assets and liabilities total' is the exact residual between cash generated by operations and pretax income plus noncash adjustments. It includes pension and non-current operating-liability movements, not solely current working capital.

Core NWC = trade accounts receivable + related-party trade accounts receivable + inventories − trade accounts payable. It intentionally excludes separately presented notes receivable, contract assets/liabilities, other current assets/payables, cash, tax balances and debt. Broader working capital is not silently equated to this narrow definition. Core cash working-capital effect = cash-flow receivables + inventory + trade-payables movements; balance-sheet changes may differ due to acquisitions, FX and other noncash effects. The all-current-assets minus all-current-liabilities measure is a separate liquidity statistic, not operating NWC.

Borrowings excluding leases = short-term loans + current portion of long-term liabilities + noncurrent bonds + noncurrent long-term loans. This sum reconciles in every year with note-disclosed short-term loans + bonds including current portion + loans including current portion. Leases are separate. Other financial liabilities, including the USCXM investor-repurchase obligation before July 2023, and customer/capacity guarantee deposits are separately retained; they are not silently combined into ordinary borrowings. The issuer's capital-management 'net debt' definition based on total liabilities less cash is not used as financial debt.

Cash is the balance-sheet cash-and-cash-equivalents amount, reconciled to both the cash flow statement and cash note. Time deposits within cash equivalents must not be added again. Longer-maturity amortized-cost assets, FVTPL/FVOCI portfolios and equity-method investments remain separate; no blanket assumption makes all portfolios cash-equivalent or freely distributable. Cash-plus-amortized-cost-current is a labeled arithmetic subtotal, not proof of unrestricted liquidity.

Issued shares from audited balance-sheet capital annotations are rounded to thousand shares and explicitly tagged issued_shares_m_rounded. They include treasury shares and are not a treasury-adjusted valuation denominator. The dividend table's 'outstanding' label is not relied on because it matches issued capital. EPS-weighted basic/diluted shares are sourced directly from the EPS note and describe the year's EPS denominator, not current fully diluted shares or ADS count.

## Comparative changes and breaks

Preserve the original audited presentation, and consult latest comparatives plus the change ledger for consistent classifications. The extracted financial fields identify two changes with four later observations:

1. 2016 cash-flow prepayments (−9,455.729) and other current assets (+815.618) were later combined as other current assets (−8,640.111). CFO and consolidated profit did not change. The source tables reconcile this exactly; no issuer statement of an error correction was found. The standardized field cf_other_current_assets_including_prepayments uses the separate lines only when they exist in that specific filing, otherwise the aggregate row.
2. 2021 longer-maturity time deposits of 28,834.684 were reclassified from other current assets into financial assets at amortized cost in the 2022 comparative. Original amortized-cost-current assets 20.000 and other current assets 31,822.866 become 28,854.684 and 2,988.182. Assets and cash equivalents do not change. Use the latest comparative when comparing longer-maturity deposits across years.

2018 IFRS9 and IFRS15 adoption used modified retrospective transition without restating 2016–2017. 2019 IFRS16 adoption also did not restate comparatives. October 2019 USJC consolidation added a genuine acquisition perimeter; 2019 contains only three months of the acquired operation, 2020 a full year. USCXM was already consolidated before its July 2023 outside-investor buyout; its settlement is financing cash flow, not a new consolidation or ordinary PPE expenditure. The 2022 IAS37 amendment had opening equity/liability effects without comparative restatement. Smaller deconsolidations and loan covenant-driven current/noncurrent reclassifications are documented separately.

## Validation and limits

Twelve checks per year (120 total) reconcile cash note/balance sheet; short debt note; aggregate borrowing note; revenue/cost/gross profit; pretax/tax/net income; parent/NCI attribution; total assets/liabilities/equity; parent/NCI equity; CFO/investing/financing/FX cash bridge; beginning/ending cash bridge; ending cash/balance-sheet cash; and CFO interest/dividend/tax reconciliation. All 120 pass within NT$0.00001m (rounding tolerance); no missing checks or parser issues remain. This is a reproducible source-to-table and accounting-identity validation, not an independent audit opinion. It does not imply all notes, contingencies or normalization adjustments were exhaustively audited.

Raw filings remain local/private source evidence. A public report should link to SEC originals and publish only derived tables and brief attributed analysis, not mirror filing full text.
